deploy-bot: Deploy to staging started :rocket:
env=staging, image=redwood/runtime:release-2026-03-20-rc5, commit=7f3b2a9, build=20260320.7, triggered_by=@laura
artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/release-2026-03-20/7f3b2a9.tar.gz
migrations=none, feature_flags=[reranker_v2:false], rollout=canary-10%

laura: starting 10% canary across us-west-2 nodes. I'll watch p95 latency and error budget.

mike: noted. enabling heap and KV cache tracing for the canary group. forwarding logs to /deploy/staging/20260320-rc5

sanjay: watching reranker qps and tail-latency. if reranker p99 > 800ms for 5m we consider pause/rollback.

ops-bot: smoke checks queued: /health, /generate-smoke, /embed-smoke. timeout=10s each.

ops-bot: smoke check /health OK (200) ; /generate-smoke OK (sample token output) ; /embed-smoke WARNING (1/5 requests timed out, 504)

carla: seeing one embed timeout in smoke. could be transient AWS infra. holding a bit before deciding.

mike: can we retry embed smoke on the same host? if it passes, likely transient. kicking one manual retry now.

ops-bot: embed-smoke retry OK (0.45s) on instance i-0a9f34; original timeouts traced to a congested host.

laura: good — canary healthy. shifting to 50% for next 15m. retention alert: watch error-rate and p99-kv-lookup.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift: 10% -> 50% complete. Instances updated: 12 -> 56. rollout-id=roll-20260320-rc5-42

mike: after 10m of 50%, p95 steady, error-rate baseline +0.04%. memory ~stable. no abnormal GC spikes.

sanjay: reranker p99 at 680ms -> acceptable. continuing to 100% in 10m unless regression.

laura: moving to 100% now. pinned model variant remains reranker_v1 until we flip. note in release notes: debugging flags enabled for 24h.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete. Duration=00:17:24. image_digest=sha256:9c8e4f3b...

ops-bot: post-deploy smoke: /health OK; /generate-smoke OK; /embed-smoke OK. automated canary checks PASSED (latency, errors within thresholds).

carla: quick note: small uptick in embed tail latency on two hosts ~30s after 100% shift, dropped back. opened ticket INF-3124 to track and triage.

mike: +1 for INF-3124. I captured traces and host ids. not blocking. recommend no rollback.

laura: same — no rollback. we'll monitor for 60m, if error-rate > 0.5% or reranker p99 > 900ms we'll roll back to release-2026-03-13 (commit d4e2c1a). otherwise mark rc5 as promoted to staging-stable.

deploy-bot: Annotated rollout: promote-proposal=staging-stable if health ok after 60m. provenance: pipeline/ci#4497, changelog=https://internal/release/2026-03-20-rc5

laura: I'll update the release notes and ping product for canary validation. tagging the repo: git tag release-2026-03-20-rc5 7f3b2a9 && git push origin --tags

mike: FYI scheduling a quick postmortem board if INF-3124 persists. leaving monitoring hooks for 2h.

deploy-bot: Deploy thread closed (observing window active). If anyone wants a rollback now, reply with "rollback" and the bot will pause rollout and open a rollback runbook.
